name: Spam, Phishing & Commercial Deception
description: Rules and guidelines for detecting unsolicited commercial bulk messages, deceptive affiliate links, phishing attempts, financial/crypto scams, engagement manipulation, bot-generated gibberish, and repetitive content flooding.

severity_levels.critical: Credential harvesting, phishing links, malware distribution, or direct financial theft scams.
severity_levels.high: Crypto pyramid schemes, counterfeit goods selling, fake giveaways, or account hijacking bots.
severity_levels.medium: Unsolicited promotional link dumping, affiliate link spamming, or repetitive posting.
severity_levels.low: Borderline promotional posts, minor engagement bait, or excessive hashtag usage.

rules.name: Phishing & Credential Theft
rules.description: Links or messages designed to trick users into revealing sensitive passwords, 2FA tokens, session cookies, or banking credentials by mimicking legitimate services.

violating: URGENT: Your account has been suspended! Verify your password immediately at http://paypa1-security-check.ru/login.
Your bank card is compromised. Click here to confirm your card number, PIN, and CVV to prevent lock out.
Free $500 gift card! Login with your Google account here to claim.
non_violating: Official in-app notifications from the system sent via authenticated channels.
Educational articles detailing how to recognize phishing email signatures.
Security analysts sharing sanitized malware indicators (defanged URLs like hxxp://example[.]com).

rules.context_notes: Examine URL structures, domain spoofing (typosquatting), and urgency tactics.

rules.name: Financial, Crypto & Get-Rich-Quick Scams
rules.description: Promoting fraudulent investment opportunities, Ponzi schemes, guaranteed high-return cryptocurrency trading bots, fake forex signals, or pyramid structures.

violating: Invest $200 today with our AI automated crypto trading bot and withdraw $3,500 guaranteed profit in 24 hours! DM on WhatsApp.
Elon Musk is giving away 5,000 ETH! Send 0.5 ETH to the wallet address below to receive 1 ETH back instantly.
Lost money to scammers? Contact Mr. Robert on Telegram to recover 100% of your lost funds guaranteed.
non_violating: Legitimate educational discussions on stock index funds, ETFs, or market trends.
Cryptocurrency technology discussions, blockchain protocol research.
Financial planning blogs discussing emergency funds or budgeting basics.

rules.context_notes: Promises of zero-risk guaranteed extraordinary returns and requests to contact third-party messaging apps (Telegram, WhatsApp) are hallmark scam patterns.

rules.name: Unsolicited Bulk Commercial Content & Link Dumping
rules.description: Posting unsolicited advertisements, affiliate links, coupon codes, product sales pitches, or website link dumping unrelated to the topic of discussion.
indicators: click my bio link for sale

violating: Cheap replica luxury watches! Click here www.replicawatches247.shop for 80% discount.
Dropping unrelated affiliate links across 50 user discussion threads about health topics.
Buy followers, likes and views fast and cheap! Visit cheapgrowthsocial.net.
non_violating: A creator linking to their portfolio or GitHub project in response to a request for examples.
Answering someone's explicit query: 'What microphone do you use?' with an honest product link.
Sharing an open-source tool link in a developer community discussion.

rules.context_notes: Evaluate relevance to the thread context and whether the user is repeatedly spamming identical links across threads.

rules.name: Repetitive Flooding & Bot Automation
rules.description: Flooding platforms with duplicate messages, high-frequency repetitive posts, randomized character strings, or automated scraping regurgitation.

violating: Posting the exact same sentence 30 times in 2 minutes across different post threads.
Flooding comment sections with automated gibberish strings 'ajsdf8923h kasdf9823'.
Automated bots reposting scraped content from other websites to game ranking algorithms.
non_violating: Accidental duplicate submission caused by network latency / retry (rate-limit handles this).
Legitimate code snippets or test inputs in a technical debugging forum.
Repeating a formal announcement across distinct authorized announcement boards.

rules.context_notes: Distinguish between technical network duplicate retries and deliberate multi-post spam flooding.

rules.name: Malicious Downloads & Drive-By Malware
rules.description: Links leading to executable malware, trojans, spyware, ransomware, cracked illegal software packed with viruses, or drive-by download pages.

violating: Download GTA 6 for PC free full crack installer here: bit.ly/free-gta6-installer.exe.
Your media player is outdated! Click here to download the required update plugin (setup.scr).
Free cheats / wallhack for Valorant download zip no virus password123.
non_violating: Links to verified official GitHub releases or trusted package managers (npm, pip, maven).
Cybersecurity advisories discussing CVE vulnerabilities with sample hashes.
Official software download pages on canonical developer domains.

rules.context_notes: High risk of device compromise and data theft. Immediate blocking of shortened URLs linking to executables.

rules.name: Deceptive Engagement Farming & Fake Contests
rules.description: Deceptive posts promising fake rewards, smartphones, or cars in exchange for sharing, commenting, or filling out third-party survey lead-generation forms.
indicators: comment win to get an iphone
complete survey to win $1000 amazon gift card

violating: We have 500 unsealed iPhone 15s that can't be sold! Comment 'IPHONE' and share to 5 groups to receive one free!
MrBeast is giving $10,000 to the first 100 people who click this link and complete a 2-minute survey!
Type 'YES' letter by letter without being interrupted to win $5,000 cash prize.
non_violating: Verified brand contests with clear terms and conditions and verifiable winners.
Interactive community quizzes or trivia conducted for social entertainment without deceptive prizes.
Legitimate academic survey research recruiting voluntary participants.

rules.context_notes: Scrutinize requests for sharing cascades and deceptive survey walls that harvest user data without providing the promised rewards.
